snippet.title: Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure - Trailer
snippet.description:
Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure - Trailer

Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure, released in Japan as The Puppet Princess of Marl Kingdom (マール王国の人形姫 Māru-ōkoku no Ningyō-hime), is a tactical role-playing game for the PlayStation developed by Nippon Ichi Software, the creators of Disgaea, and is the first installment in the Marl Kingdom series.

Device:
Playstation Classic
Bleemsync 1.2
OTG
Sandisk Cruzer Blade 128 GB
